macro.overnight_read: USD shows strength against EUR, GBP and AUD while JPY remains steady; crypto is sideways with low fear (FG 28) suggesting a possible bounce in BTC and ETH; expect a modestly bullish open for risk assets but keep an eye on upcoming jobless claims and PPI data.
macro.summary: The market is in a choppy range with moderate volatility and a slightly loose financial environment. We stay aggressive (risk appetite 70) and tilt toward tactical plays, focusing on USD‑JPY, USD‑CAD, gold, oil and the dip‑buy opportunity in BTC/ETH.
